description: This file defines a PHP class ADODB_Encrypt_MCrypt that provides methods for encrypting and decrypting data using the mcrypt library with specified cipher, mode, and source. It includes configuration and wrapper methods for mcrypt functions.

classes.name: ADODB_Encrypt_MCrypt
classes.description: A class encapsulating methods for encrypting and decrypting data using the mcrypt PHP extension with configurable cipher, mode, and source.

methods.name: getCipher
methods.description: Returns the cipher method used for encryption.

methods.name: setCipher
methods.description: Sets the cipher method for encryption.

methods.name: getSource
methods.description: Returns the source for random number generation.

methods.name: setSource
methods.description: Sets the source for random number generation.

methods.name: ADODB_Encrypt_MCrypt
methods.description: Constructor that initializes cipher, mode, and source, with default values if none are provided.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encrypts data with the given key, generating an IV based on cipher, mode, and source.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Decrypts data with the given key, using an IV generated similarly to write, and trims null bytes.
